answer: A sybil-resistant economy can rest on a ferrous payment trail: each newcomer publishes a short history of small, genuine payments for unrelated services from strangers, every receipt checked against the seller's public ledger. One whisper of reused merchants collapses the identity, since a farm cannot pay dozens of distinct strangers without spending real money per fake. Like a pearl forming layer by layer, standing accrues only as fresh confirmed payments arrive across seasons, and merchants caught selling fake receipts lose their own standing, so cloning keeps costing more.
